Our actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including those set forth under “Item 3. Key Information—D. Risk Factors” or in other parts of this annual report on Form 20-F. 125 Table of Contents A. Operating Results Key Factors Affecting Our Results of Operations User growth and engagement Our ability to grow our user base and maintain and increase user engagement is critical to our success. We have experienced solid user growth in the past two years. The following table sets forth our average DAUs and MAUs for each of the quarters indicated: For the Three Months Ended March 31, 2024 June 30, 2024 September 30, 2024 December 31, 2024 March 31, 2025 June 30, 2025 September 30, 2025 December 31, 2025 (In millions) Average DAUs (1)(3) 102.4 102.3 107.3 103.0 106.7 109.4 117.3 113.0 Average MAUs (2)(3) 341.5 335.8 347.8 339.6 367.6 362.8 376.2 366.2 Note: (1) Average DAU is calculated by dividing the sum of DAU during the specified period by the number of days in such period. (2) Average MAU is calculated by dividing the sum of MAU during the specified period by the number of months in such period. (3) We count our active users as the sum of active users on mobile apps and on PC during a given period. Active users on mobile apps refer to the number of mobile devices (including smart TV and other smart devices) that have launched our mobile apps during a given period. Active users on PC refer to the sum of valid logged-in users who visit our website at www.bilibili.com on PC and who engage in PC application during a given period, after eliminating duplicates. Our active users generally view and consume a multitude of content offered on our platform, including videos, live broadcasting, mobile games and other content. The number of our users and the level of their engagement on our platform affect our revenues. We had solid growth in the revenues generated from VAS mainly due to the increasing numbers of active viewers of our live broadcasting and subscribers of our premium membership program and our other value-added services. Our advertising revenue is driven by the size of our user base, the engagement of our users and our brand equity. Mobile game user base growth and engagement are primarily driven by the launch of new games and the release of content updates of our existing games. We believe DAU reflects the quality and sustainability of our community, which is also directly linked to our commercial prospects. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Summary of Risk Factors Our business is subject to a number of risks, including risks that may prevent us from achieving our business objectives or may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, and prospects. With respect to the legal risks associated with being based in and having operations in mainland China as discussed in relevant risk factors under “—Risks Related to Our Corporate Structure” and “—Risks Related to Doing Business in China,” the laws, regulations and the discretion of mainland China governmental authorities discussed in this annual report are expected to apply to mainland China entities and businesses, rather than entities or businesses in Hong Kong which operate under a different set of laws from mainland China. These risks are discussed more fully under “Item 3. Key Information—D. Risk Factors.” Risks Related to Our Business and Industry • We operate in a fast-evolving industry. We cannot guarantee that we will successfully implement our commercialization strategies or develop new ones, or generate sustainable revenues and profit. • We incurred net losses in the past and we may not be able to maintain profitability in the future. • If we fail to anticipate user preferences and provide products and services to attract and retain users, or if we fail to keep up with rapid changes in technologies and their impact on user behavior, we may not be able to attract sufficient user traffic to remain competitive, and our business and prospects may be materially and adversely affected. • Our business depends on our ability to provide users with interesting and useful content, which in turn depends on the content contributed by the content creators on our platform. • Our business generates and processes a large amount of data, and we are required to comply with PRC and other applicable laws relating to privacy and cybersecurity. The improper use or disclosure of data could have a material and adverse effect on our business and prospects. • Any compromise of the cybersecurity of our platform could materially and adversely affect our business, operations and reputation. • Any increases in the content costs on our platform may have an adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations. • If the content contained within videos, live broadcasting, games, audios and other content formats on our platform is deemed to violate any PRC laws or regulations, our business, financial condition and results of operations may be materially and adversely affected. • If the content contained within videos, live broadcasting, games, audios and other content formats on our platform is considered inappropriate or offensive, our business, financial condition and results of operations may be materially and adversely affected. 17 Table of Contents Risks Related to Our Corporate Structure • Bilibili Inc. is a Cayman Islands holding company conducting our operations primarily through its PRC subsidiaries, the VIEs and their subsidiaries in mainland China; we have no equity ownership in the VIEs and their subsidiaries. credit_strengths.text: Bilibili's revenue base has compounded steadily across the disclosed annual trend, with operating income swinging from losses to a modest profit, indicating the platform's commercialization strategy is gaining traction and the cost structure is scaling more efficiently than in prior periods.

Operating cash flow has grown materially over the trend period and comfortably funds capital expenditure, leaving substantial free cash flow. This internally generated liquidity, rather than external borrowing, is the primary source of debt service and reinvestment capacity.

key_risks.text: The risk-factor passage flags that Bilibili incurred net losses in the past and may not maintain profitability, while content costs, user-preference shifts and PRC regulatory or cybersecurity developments could pressure margins. These are concrete, issuer-specific exposures for a platform whose economics depend on creator content and user engagement.

The debt note shows a large current portion of long-term debt and convertible senior notes falling due within a year, alongside short-term loans. This concentrates refinancing and repayment needs in the near term, and the convertible component introduces potential equity dilution or cash settlement risk if not refinanced.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is comfortable and sits above the sector median, while free cash flow to debt is strong relative to peers. Cash balances exceed total debt, producing net cash on a reported basis, so the issuer's ability to meet interest and principal from internal resources is well supported.

Gross leverage is modest and near the sector median, but the maturity profile is front-loaded: a significant share of debt is current. Refinancing this current portion is the key test of debt-servicing capacity, and success depends on continued operating cash flow generation and access to onshore or offshore funding.

overall_credit_view.text: Bilibili presents a minimal indicative financial risk profile, with net cash, strong free cash flow conversion and interest coverage above the sector median. The credit story is one of improving profitability and cash generation, though the margin remains thin relative to sector peers and the track record of profitability is short.

The main credit watch items are the concentrated near-term maturities, including convertible notes, and the risk that content costs or regulatory actions disrupt the cash-flow trajectory. Shareholder returns via buybacks absorb a modest portion of free cash flow, leaving ample buffer, but refinancing execution remains the pivotal forward-looking judgement.

credit_strengths.text: 嗶哩嗶哩的收入基礎在披露的年度趨勢中穩步複合增長，經營收入從虧損轉為小幅盈利，表明平台的商業化策略正在取得進展，成本結構的規模化效率較以往期間有所提升。
經營現金流在趨勢期內大幅增長，並能輕鬆覆蓋資本開支，留下可觀的自由現金流。這種內部產生的流動性，而非外部借款，是償債和再投資能力的主要來源。

key_risks.text: 風險因素段落指出，嗶哩嗶哩過去曾錄得淨虧損，且可能無法維持盈利能力，而內容成本、用戶偏好轉變以及中國監管或網絡安全發展可能對利潤率構成壓力。這些是具體的、發行人特有的風險敞口，對於一個經濟效益依賴創作者內容和用戶參與度的平台而言尤為如此。
債務附註顯示，長期債務和可轉換優先票據中有大額流動部分將於一年內到期，同時還有短期貸款。這將再融資和償還需求集中在近期，而可轉換部分若未能再融資，則會帶來潛在的股權攤薄或現金結算風險。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率充裕，高於行業中位數，而自由現金流對債務的比率相對於同業較強。現金餘額超過總債務，按報告基準產生淨現金，因此發行人以內部資源償付利息和本金的能力得到良好支撐。
總槓桿率適度，接近行業中位數，但到期結構前置：相當大比例的債務為流動債務。對這部分流動債務進行再融資是償債能力的關鍵考驗，成功與否取決於持續的經營現金流產生以及境內或境外融資渠道的暢通。

overall_credit_view.text: 嗶哩嗶哩呈現出極低的指示性財務風險狀況，擁有淨現金、強勁的自由現金流轉換以及高於行業中位數的利息覆蓋率。其信用故事是盈利能力和現金產生能力的改善，儘管利潤率相對於行業同業仍然偏薄，且盈利記錄較短。
主要的信用觀察事項是集中的近期到期債務（包括可轉換票據），以及內容成本或監管行動可能擾亂現金流軌跡的風險。通過回購進行的股東回報僅佔用一小部分自由現金流，留有充足緩衝，但再融資的執行仍然是關鍵的前瞻性判斷。
